verdict.rationale: Only community comments touch on export. Users describe exporting individual icons as SVG per asset, using 'Copy as SVG', and relying on a bulk-export plugin, which confirms basic per-layer SVG export but shows the bulk workflow needs extra tools. missing for 10: first-party documentation of export settings, PNG and PDF export evidence, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers, slices, and native bulk export.
